info.title: FScript CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for running FScript programs with sandboxed filesystem externs and script arguments.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Override sandbox root directory for filesystem
externs.

options.name: --no-default-externs
options.description:
Disable default runtime externs from
FScript.Runtime.Registry.

options.name: --extern-assembly
options.description:
Load external-function providers from an assembly
path (repeatable).
